prompt:
Warm, candid work orientation: an experienced female cleaner with dark braided hair and a new younger male recruit with brown curly hair, both clearly different, side by side in a modest communal staff kitchenette. The senior colleague demonstrates how to fold one turquoise microfibre cloth into quarters on a waist-high oak worktable; the recruit watches closely with his own cloth flat in front of him. Photograph this small interaction at a slightly elevated 45-degree angle showing both attentive faces, both distinct white company embroideries and the cloth-folding hands. Mid shot, ordinarily lived-in cream tile wall and high clerestory windows, early afternoon light, 40mm. No one looks into camera, no signs or certificates, no reflections duplicating people.

Each Ketuvi employee wears an amethyst purple cotton-knit short-sleeved polo with the fabric's midtone based on #B35CFF, an understated but plainly visible white embroidered KetuviClean logo on the left chest, dark slate work trousers #374345 and practical dark work shoes when in frame. Logo reference: use the attached exact company geometric K and KetuviClean lettering, in plain white thread, following polo perspective; never replace it by a generic K or an invented mark, no colored patch. Only employees wear uniforms. Any microfibre in view is Ketuvi turquoise #17C3B2. The reference supplies only logo geometry; create an entirely original photographic scene.

Create one original natural on-location photographic reportage image, 3840×2160 horizontal 16:9 single exposure. Aim for a premium but honest editorial feature about everyday cleaning in Quebec. Believable hands, facial skin texture, pores, fabric folds, retained window highlights, real contact shadows and subtle lens imperfections. Documentary, quietly luminous, no CGI, no image composites, no overlaid words, no dramatic color wash, no studio backdrop, no text graphic on the picture, no decorative sparkles, no watermark. Realistic anatomy and simple well-formed hand interactions.
